description: The diagonal halting set is \(\Sigma_1\)-definable and is not \(\Pi_1\)-definable; its complement is \(\Pi_1\)-definable and is not \(\Sigma_1\)-definable.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticDefinability.halting_separation :
  have K := fun v => v 0 ∈ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.UniversalComputation.haltingDiagonal;
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticDefinability.SigmaOneDefinable K ∧
    ¬Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticDefinability.PiOneDefinable K ∧
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticDefinability.PiOneDefinable fun v => ¬K v) ∧
        ¬Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticDefinability.SigmaOneDefinable fun v => ¬K v
